methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly and called with a mock copy_from_env function that writes crafted JSON to a temp file, simulating the export_result.sh output. Four scenarios tested per task: (1) do-nothing — raises FileNotFoundError → score=0, passed=False; (2) partial — some criteria met, others not → score<60, passed=False; (3) full — all criteria met → score=100, passed=True; (4) wrong-target — irrelevant data (different mailbox/user names) → score=0, passed=False. No Docker/VM required.
notes: Do-nothing=0. Partial (tagged+admin_assign only)=45 pts, passed=False. Full (all 6 criteria)=100/100, passed=True. Wrong-target (no actions)=0 pts.
